children.text:
At King Spa, the Relax & Soothing Facial offers a rejuvenating escape for those seeking a relaxing skin care experience. This signature treatment employs expert facial massage techniques to deeply relax your facial muscles, while carefully removing dead skin cells to reveal a fresh and luminous complexion.

Our skilled estheticians use our signature shea butter and cooling soothing masks, tailored to your skin’s needs, leaving you feeling refreshed and revitalized. Indulge in the ultimate facial massage that balances your skin, reduces oil buildup, and ensures long-lasting relaxation

children.text:
The Relax & Soothing Facial is ideal for those seeking a gentle yet effective skin care treatment to restore their skin’s natural balance and beauty. If you’ve spent a day out in the sun, or recently undergone an intensive skin treatment, this facial is perfect for soothing and calming your skin problems.

Individuals with excess oil production or recurring breakouts will benefit from the oil-balancing properties of this treatment, which helps to prevent future acne flare-ups. This facial is also suited for those desiring deep relaxation, as the soothing facial massage techniques help ease facial muscle tension, leaving you feeling calm, refreshed, and revitalized.

  • Sun-Exposed Skin: Ideal for those needing to soothe and restore their skin after prolonged sun exposure.
  • Post-Treatment Care: Perfect for individuals seeking gentle care after recent intensive skin treatments.
  • Acne-Prone/Oily Skin: Beneficial for clients with excess oil production or frequent breakouts, helping to balance oil levels.
  • Relaxation Seekers: Suited for individuals desiring deep relaxation through expert facial massage techniques.
  • Tense Facial Muscles: Great for those looking to relieve facial muscle tension while refreshing their complexion.

heading.html: Benefits of the Relax & Soothing Facial

children.text:
Indulge in the rejuvenating benefits of King Spa’s Relax & Soothing Facial, crafted to provide a comprehensive and calming experience. This luxurious facial treatment combines effective skincare with soothing massage therapy to promote healthy, balanced, and radiant skin:

  • Facial Massage for Relaxation: The relaxing facial includes gentle facial massages designed to relieve stress and ease facial muscle tension, leaving you with a refreshed and calm sensation.
  • Soothing Sensitive Skin: The specialized shea butter and cooling masks provide deep hydration to sensitive skin, promoting a balanced complexion while minimizing irritation.
  • Healthy Skin Restoration: By removing dead skin cells, unclogging pores, and boosting blood circulation, this facial helps regulate oil production and encourages healthy skin, reducing the likelihood of acne and breakouts.
  • Comprehensive Treatment: The blend of relaxing massage therapy, nourishing masks, and expert skin care techniques ensures a holistic facial treatment, offering deep relaxation and helping to relieve stress from the body while enhancing your skin’s vitality.

heading.html: What to Expect During Your Relaxing Facial Treatment

children.text:
Prepare to unwind and rejuvenate with our Relax & Soothing Facial, designed to provide a calming yet effective skincare experience. During this relaxing facial treatment, you’ll enjoy a sequence of steps carefully crafted to cleanse, nourish, and relax your skin, leaving you with a radiant, balanced complexion.

Here’s a closer look at what you can expect during this revitalizing journey:

  1. Deep Cleansing: The Relax & Soothing Facial begins with a thorough deep cleansing to remove impurities and unclog pores. This initial step creates a fresh base for the rest of the facial treatment, allowing the skin to fully absorb the beneficial ingredients.
  2. Exfoliation: A gentle exfoliation follows, designed to slough off dead skin cells and promote increased blood flow, revealing a smoother, healthier complexion. The exfoliation is carefully chosen to suit sensitive skin and those with dry skin concerns.
  3. Facial Massage: Next, a relaxing facial massage is performed to relieve tension from the forehead and face while also increasing circulation and relieving sinus pressure. This helps soothe facial muscles and leaves you with a deeply relaxing experience.
  4. Mask Application: Our signature shea butter and soothing cool masks are then applied to nourish and hydrate, promoting healthy, radiant, and rejuvenated skin. The shea butter mask helps lock in moisture, while the cool mask soothes sensitive or irritated skin, ensuring balanced hydration and improved texture.
  5. Anti-Aging Serum: To enhance the facial’s anti-aging benefits, a specially formulated serum is gently massaged into your skin, helping to reduce fine lines and promote increased elasticity.
  6. Moisturizing and Protection: The treatment concludes with a hydrating moisturizer, leaving your skin feeling protected, balanced, and revitalized.

heading.html: Why Choose King Spa for Your Skin Care Needs

children.text:
At King Spa, we believe in delivering an unparalleled experience that rejuvenates your body and mind. Here’s why we’re the best choice for your facials:

  • Expertise and Care: Our estheticians are trained professionals who understand the nuances of different skin types and conditions. Their expertise ensures that each facial is customized to your specific needs, whether it’s soothing sensitive skin or promoting a radiant complexion.

  • Signature Treatments: Our Relax & Soothing Facial uses carefully selected products like shea butter and cooling masks to provide maximum nourishment and hydration. These signature treatments are designed to calm and balance your skin, giving you lasting results.

  • Relaxing Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in our serene and welcoming spa environment that promotes a completely relaxed state for the entire body and mind. From the moment you arrive, until you leave, you’ll enjoy a stress-free oasis that enhances the benefits of your facial.

  • Comprehensive Spa Experience: Beyond facials, King Spa offers a range of facilities and services, including massage therapy with essential oils, traditional Korean body scrubs, mineral hot saunas, hot tubs, steam rooms, and so much more, ensuring your entire spa journey is complete.

  • Customer Satisfaction: Our commitment to customer satisfaction is evident in our attentive service, personalized approach, and glowing reviews from clients. Your relaxation and satisfaction are our top priorities.

heading.html: How to Book Your Relax & Soothing Facial

children.text:
Visit Us at Our Second-Floor Kiosk

Booking your Relax & Soothing Facial at King Spa is simple and convenient. Visit our second-floor kiosk to reserve your treatment in person. All facials operate on a first-come, first-served basis, so we recommend arriving early to secure your spot.

Our friendly staff will guide you through the booking process, ensuring your facial treatment is tailored to your specific concerns and needs. Treat yourself to a relaxing facial and leave with rejuvenated skin and a refreshed spirit!

children.html:
Who is the Relax & Soothing Facial suitable for?

The Relax & Soothing Facial is ideal for anyone seeking a relaxing facial treatment to soothe their skin, clear clogged pores, and rejuvenate their complexion. It’s especially beneficial for those looking to relieve stress, balance oil production, and maintain an overall healthy appearance.

What benefits does the facial massage provide?

The relaxing facial massage in this treatment helps increase blood flow, firm the skin, and relieve muscle tension. The firm pressure techniques used across the entire face in the massage promote collagen production for anti-aging benefits while easing stress and providing deep relaxation.

How does this treatment help with anti-aging concerns?

This facial treatment uses nourishing serums and masks that stimulate collagen production, aiding in skin elasticity and diminishing fine lines and wrinkles.  The facial massage also helps improve blood circulation, contributing to a firmer, more youthful overall appearance.

What specific skin concerns does this facial treat?

This facial is particularly effective for soothing sensitive skin, balancing excess oil, and reducing acne and breakouts. It helps treat clogged pores, dry patches, and skin exposed to the sun, leaving it balanced and radiant.

What should I do after the treatment to maintain results?

After the facial, we recommend continuing a good skin care regimen and protecting your skin from the sun to maintain your rejuvenated complexion. Our estheticians can advise on post-treatment care for lasting results.

How long does the treatment last?

The Relax & Soothing Facial typically lasts 60 minutes, allowing enough time for deep cleansing, massage, and mask application while leaving you feeling refreshed and revitalized with more beautiful skin than ever before.
